label: A CONTAINED_IN_1 individuating stand-in guiding value-dependent favouring is apprehended
paraphrase: OPEN containment-recognition bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every bearer b with a favouring determination of profile phi, every scenario s and candidates z, w: if phi depends on betterness (read as value) with end-realization held fixed (BECAUSE_OF_GOODNESS_2) for z over w or for w over z at s, z is not a present input at s, b's stand-in for z is contained in b (CONTAINED_IN_1), and it differs from b's stand-in for w, then that stand-in is a content about z and b itself apprehends it (so it is contained in the sense CONTAINED_IN_2). Given the other premises of the registered derivation every good-general bearer meets its antecedent, so its added antecedent conditions narrow nothing there; with those premises it is strictly stronger than the cognition criterion (the criterion implies its weakened form, the weakened form with those premises gives the criterion, and on the control carrier the criterion and those premises hold while this bridge fails). It is the passage from generic to intentional containment. A virtual reading of the containment (CONTAINED_IN_3: a power to produce z, or a mode in which the bearer is imitable by z, not apprehended) denies it; nothing in the Lean types beyond Apprehends separates the two readings.
